entities.summary: Khatsun Namkha Lekpa Gyaltsen, orthographic spelling, mK'as btsun nam mk'a legs pa'i rgyal mts'an, who lived from (1305-1343) was a ruler of Sakya, which had a precedence position in Tibet under the Yuan dynasty. He also held the title of guoshi from 1325 to his dethronement in 1341.
